name: tc-chat-sse
goal: The Crew, Phase 2 (2026-10-24): Kris wants The Crew to be its own Claude Desktop / Antigravity - a chat with the selected PA that assigns crew jobs. The chat follows each PA through OpenCode's HTTP event stream; sse.rs turns the stream's bytes into whole events. Small and exact: Larry's kind of single task (relay ladder behind him).

tasks.instructions: Keep a Vec<u8> buffer; only complete lines (up to a newline byte) are turned into Strings with from_utf8_lossy, so chunks may split anywhere. Strip the byte-order mark from the first line of the stream only. The last id carries over between events; the event name and the data lines are cleared at every blank line. Walk every row of the worked-example table through your code. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
